subject: Stakeholder demo windows — DST clash & regional reviewers
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Peter Nguyen <peter.nguyen@orbitalhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 14:12:00 -0500
Subject: Redwood demo — aligning regional reviewers and windows

Hi Peter —

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood Dedicated / Private for Orbital Health. To make the upcoming demo useful for your security reviewers, we want to line up a short joint session where we walk through:

- the deployment topology (VPC/on-prem options)
- data handling and key management (KMS/HSM)
- audit/logging and retention controls

Can you confirm who will join from your side? You mentioned an EU DPO and an APAC security lead — if you can share names and availability that helps.

Because of DST changes next weekend in the US (clocks jump forward), we want to avoid last-minute confusion on times. Proposed options (all on Tue/Wed next week):

A) One 60m live session: 14:00 UTC — would be 10:00 ET / 15:00 CET / 23:00 SGT (tight for APAC)
B) Split sessions: EU+US overlap at 13:00 UTC (09:00 ET / 14:00 CET) + APAC deep-dive at 01:00 UTC next day (09:00 SGT)

If neither works, we can propose three short region-specific slots.

Attached: demo-outline-v1.pdf (agenda + roles).

Goal: have EU DPO (privacy), APAC security lead (infra), and a stakeholder from your engineering/infra team. From our side I'll join, plus Laura for security details and Hiro for deployment specifics.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
> Attachments: demo-outline-v1.pdf
From: Peter Nguyen <peter.nguyen@orbitalhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Kovac <elena.kovac@orbhealth.eu>, Anjali Rao <anjali.rao@orbitalhealth-apac.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — aligning regional reviewers and windows

Diego —

Appreciate the clear options. Quick clarifications from our side:

- EU DPO is Elena Kovac (copied). She prefers no meetings after 17:30 CET.
- APAC security lead is Anjali Rao (copied). She is available between 09:00–13:00 SGT on Tue/Wed next week.
- Our infra lead (Sanjay) can join for the deep-dive but not the executive hour.

Given those constraints, option B (split sessions) looks best. Suggested concrete times (all dates next week):

- EU+US joint: Wed 17 Mar, 13:00 UTC (09:00 ET / 14:00 CET) — Elena can do this.
- APAC deep-dive: Thu 18 Mar, 01:00 UTC (09:00 SGT) — Anjali confirmed this window works for her.

Two requests:
1) Can you shorten the APAC deep-dive to 45 minutes and focus on deployment/networking + KMS flows?
2) I'll attach the security questionnaire we've started; it'd be great if Laura or Hiro could pre-fill the portions on audit/logging capabilities.

Thanks — looking forward.

Peter
Director, Platform Engineering | Orbital Health
> Attachments: security-questionnaire-03-11.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Peter Nguyen <peter.nguyen@orbitalhealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — aligning regional reviewers and windows

Thanks Peter — and thanks for copying Elena and Anjali. A couple of operational notes from Redwood before we lock times:

1) US DST: your proposed Wed 13:00 UTC will fall on the day after the US moves clocks forward (Sun 14 Mar). For a US-based participant joining in ET, the local time will flip — just flagging in case other attendees are booking recurring blocks.

2) Splitting into a short EU+US joint session + a focused APAC deep-dive is the right approach. We can do the APAC session as a recorded deep-dive too if that helps scheduling.

Proposed final schedule (to confirm):
- Wed 17 Mar 2027, 13:00 UTC — 60m EU + US (live): Diego + Laura present; Elena + Peter + Sanjay expected.
- Thu 18 Mar 2027, 01:00 UTC — 45m APAC deep-dive: Hiro + Diego present; Anjali + infra attendee from Orbital. We'll record this and share logs/config snippets in Drive.

Action items:
- Peter: confirm Sanjay for the Wed session and the APAC infra attendee for Thu.
- Diego: can you create calendar invites with explicit UTC times and add the Drive link?
- Hiro/Laura: we'll pre-fill the security questionnaire and drop the answers in the Drive by EOD Mon.

I'll draft the invites with both UTC and the common local conversions to reduce confusion. Also attaching a quick availability grid I pulled from the thread so we can mark firm slots.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Product Security Lead | Redwood Inference
> Attachments: availability-grid.csv
From: Elena Kovac <elena.kovac@orbhealth.eu>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Peter Nguyen <peter.nguyen@orbitalhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Anjali Rao <anjali.rao@orbitalhealth-apac.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 08:33:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — aligning regional reviewers and windows

Diego / team —

Thanks for doing the scheduling work. Confirming: Wed 17 Mar 13:00 UTC works for me (EU DPO). A couple of asks for the EU session:

- Please include a short slide on data residency / controller vs processor responsibilities.
- If possible, provide an export of the audit-log sample (redacted) in advance; that will speed review.

If you can share the Drive folder and calendar invites with clear UTC times, I’ll accept and forward to our legal ops.

Regards,
Elena Kovac
Data Protection Officer | Orbital Health (EU)

On a separate note Anjali — thanks for being flexible on the APAC slot. If anything shifts on your side, happy to accept the recording and follow up asynchronously.
